description: Construction workers and site personnel performing manual, supervisory, installation, finishing, and inspection tasks.
Fixed tower crane used to lift and position heavy materials such as reinforcement, formwork, masonry materials, and structural elements.
Suspended crane hook/load attachment visible below a lifting crane, used for material lifting and positioning.
Mobile truck-mounted or all-terrain crane used for lifting materials and equipment at different locations on the construction site.
Road roller/compactor used to compact soil, aggregate, sub-base, and road construction layers.
Tracked earthmoving machine with a front blade used for clearing, pushing, spreading, and rough grading soil and materials.
Hydraulic excavator used for digging, trenching, loading, site clearance, and other earthmoving operations.
Site or tipper truck used to transport soil, construction materials, debris, and other loads around or away from the site.
Wheel loader used to load, move, and stockpile soil, aggregate, debris, and construction materials.
Concrete pump truck used to transfer and place ready-mix concrete through a boom or pumping system.
Concrete mixer/ready-mix vehicle used to transport and continuously mix concrete before placement.
Pile-driving machine used to install foundation piles into the ground.
Other construction-related vehicle or mobile equipment not covered by the defined equipment classes.
